title: LabelsFile
description:
`labels.yaml`. Every key is optional; a key left out keeps the app's default. Lists
(`seats`, `roles`, `find_examples`, `glossary_exceptions`, `side_words`, `plain_words`)
replace the default list;
`position_words`, reference `groups` and `basis_tags` are merged with the defaults by key.

basis_tags.description:
Words for the manifest's basis tags, by tag. A tag the manifest doesn't list is
left out of the built pack.

find_examples.description: Find's example searches; the first two are also the examples in its no-match hint.

glossary_exceptions.description: Glossary terms whose first sentence reads as a description, so no expansion is shown.

list_kinds.description: The names of the kinds of list.

methods.description: The names of the ways a list is used (its `method`).

panel_states.description: The Start page's panel-state picker words.

plain_words.description: Words that say nothing about where a control is (`AND`, `PANEL`, `SWITCH`).

position_words.description:
Other words a step's wording uses for a position, by position: `DN: [DOWN]`.
`check` and `suggest-targets` read steps with them.

reference.description: The reference area's title and group tabs.

roles.description: The crew roles steps name. The app has none by default.

seat_view_title.description: The title over the seat view in "Where is this?".

seats.description: The flight deck's seats. The app has none by default.

side_words.description: Words that tell one of a pair from the other, by side or seat (`LEFT`, `CAPTAIN`).

BasisTagLabel.description:
What a basis tag reads: its label, what kind of material it is, and whether it is a status
(a list still being checked) rather than a source.

about.description: What kind of material it is, shown with its name on the References page.

id.description: The basis tag it labels, as the manifest's `basisTags` lists it.

label.description: The tag's name on the References page.

pending.description:
`true` for a status rather than a source: the lists that carry it are still being
checked, and the References page shows them apart.

GroupLabel.description: A reference group, e.g. `memory`, and how its tab is titled.

id.description:
The group's id, lower-case letters, digits and dashes, e.g. `memory`; a reference
phase's `group` names it.

ListKindLabelsFile.description: `list_kinds` as a pack writes it: any of the names.

flow.description: A list of `kind: flow` (the app's word: Procedure).

non_normal.description: Any other list (Non-normal procedure), unless it is memory items or quick reference.

quick.description: A list in a phase whose `group` is `quick` (Quick reference).

MethodLabelsFile.description: `methods` as a pack writes it: any of the names.

do.description: A list with `method: do` (the app's word: Do).

placeholder.description: What the picker shows before a panel state is chosen.

title.description: The picker's heading on the Start page.

ReferenceLabelsFile.description: `reference` as a pack writes it. Groups are merged with the built-in ones by id.

groups.description:
Group titles. One with a built-in id (`memory`, `quick`, `procedures`) renames it;
any other adds a group after them.

title.description: The reference area's title, on its button and its page (the app's word: Emergency).

RoleLabel.description:
A crew role, e.g. `capt`. `seat` names the seat it sits in; a duty role such as `pf` or
`pm` names none.

id.description:
Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, unique among roles; a step's `role` and
`respond` name it.

seat.description:
The seat it sits in, one of the seats. A seated role's `title` and `short` also count
as side words.

short.description: Its short tag beside a step, e.g. `CA`.

title.description: Its full name, e.g. `Captain`: the short tag's tooltip, and what screen readers say.

SeatLabel.description: A seat in the flight deck, e.g. `left`. Seat frames in the overview are keyed by its id.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, unique among seats; a role's `seat` names it.
